plan.objective: Measure changed profit, loss streaks, drawdown and actual capped exposure; not select a live risk level
plan.unchanged: Max lot 0.05, 20-pip initial stop, same 2R initial target and 1R/1R trailing, EUR 150 daily limit with closing, 0.5% portfolio risk cap, one position, sizing/valuation guards, sessions and cooldown. Only configured risk_pct changes within each reference.
plan.protocol: Eight declared configurations; full earlier-year base/stress replays plus twelve monthly tests and later-six stress for every configuration. No linear P&L multiplication, parameter tuning, training nomination or live promotion.
plan.risk_measure: Maximum initial entry-to-stop price risk reconstructed against each replay's entry equity. Excludes commission, stop slippage and gaps; it is not a maximum possible loss. Declared risk_pct can remain unused because max_lot binds.
plan.streak_measure: Strict negative-net sequences, zero/nonnegative breaks the run. Counts and worst sequence cash loss reported separately. Aggregate monthly streaks join independent folds descriptively; per-fold streaks and drawdowns also retained.
limitations: The two references were selected because their previously examined historical test results were positive. This is sizing sensitivity on reused history, not evidence of a new edge or unseen validation.
The earlier year is one continuous replay, not overlapping training sums. It is reported separately and must not be hidden by the later positive test year.
Monthly folds each restart flat at EUR 10,000. Summed returns and drawdown are descriptive, not a continuously compounded account or a guaranteed income.

Historical spreads, assumed commissions/slippage, constant historical valuation. Swap/overnight financing, full tick paths and latency are not modeled. Changing only sizing preserves comparability with prior reference reports.
Higher risk budgets do not improve entry expectancy; realized losses and drawdowns can grow. No lot cap, stop, daily or portfolio protection is relaxed.
